SuperAgent 2.0.12 - Features, Fixes, and Improvements

✨ New Features
- [Settings] Settings gains a sidebar search: find any setting row across all sections (title/description/aliases, Chinese pinyin included), jump to it with scroll + highlight, full keyboard navigation.
- [Settings] Settings search now covers all sections with static settings rows, including MCP tabs.
- [Translation] The translate model now has its own temperature, top-p and reasoning effort settings, editable from the translation settings panel and the translate page toolbar.
- [Markdown] Markdown previews outside chat now use the same rich renderer as chat messages. In agent session messages and rendered artifact Markdown previews, workspace links open files in the artifact pane and directories in the system file manager; relative links resolve from the agent workspace root.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Cherry Cloud] Cherry Cloud models now honor server-declared capabilities, support configured OpenAI Chat Completions routes, and remain compatible with older model-list responses. Message token details now also show time to first token without requiring the expanded runtime breakdown.
- [Chat] Preserve partial chat responses and show a clear, retryable error when a provider stream ends without a finish reason.
- [Chat] Fix middle-click (autoscroll) scrolling in the chat message list so it no longer vibrates or jumps.
- [Chat] Sent image attachments now appear as compact filename chips with real image thumbnails, including after reopening a conversation.
- [Model Health] Model health check results no longer linger after leaving the provider page.
- [Filesystem MCP] Allow grep searches to use regular expression syntax supported by ripgrep.
- [Knowledge Base] Empty knowledge bases now appear in the knowledge list.
- [Chat Export] Prevent fraction denominators from being clipped when exporting conversations as images.
- [OpenClaw] Prevent the OpenClaw gateway from failing to start when SuperAgent uses a socks5 proxy.
- [Web Search] Web fetch no longer sends localhost, LAN, or locally-unresolvable URLs to Jina Reader when the built-in fetch fails, regardless of the “Allow fetching local network addresses” setting.
- [Topics] Pinned topics and agent sessions now keep their text aligned with unpinned items in owner-grouped lists.
- [Agent] The task progress capsule now always tracks the main agent's task plan; todo lists written by spawned subagents no longer replace it.
- [Agent] Fixed the permission-mode popup showing two highlighted rows at once, and tooltips no longer pop up on their own when the panel opens.
- [PDF Preview] Preserve colors in colored PDF documents.
- [Models] Fix reasoning mode not being available for Xunfei MaaS () custom models — their model IDs are now recognized and expose the reasoning toggle/effort controls.
- [UI] Improved Skills detail scrolling and Sidebar avatar and title-bar alignment.

💄 Improvements
- [Input Fields] Number fields across settings, model options, MCP servers, assistants and painting parameters no longer show the browser's native spinner buttons, and no longer change value when the mouse wheel scrolls over a focused field. They step with the arrow keys, announce their allowed range to screen readers, and the API gateway port now tells you when a value is out of range instead of quietly applying a different one.

⚡ Performance
- [Paintings] Improved painting history refresh performance by reusing unchanged hydrated records.

SuperAgent 2.0.11 - Features, Fixes, and Improvements

✨ New Features
- [Cherry Cloud] Sign in to Cherry Cloud for entitlement-aware Agent models, automatic local Gateway startup, quota-aware model selection, and durable Product Session handling.
- [Context Management] Configure the compression trigger threshold per assistant or globally in Settings.
- [Mini Apps] Improved installation and navigation with drag-and-drop packages, stable tabs and icons, and transparent Translate and Painting views.
- [Translate] Single-direction text translation now requires only a target language and starts without source-language detection.
- [Files] Press Ctrl+A (Cmd+A on macOS) in the file list to select all files in the current view.
- [Translate] Added an inline delete button to remove a message's translation in one click.
- [Sidebar] Hide the chat assistant from the sidebar via Appearance Settings, and launch directly to the first visible sidebar app.
- [Agent] Added a global search action to the Agent conversation toolbar.
- [Models] Add Hy4 Preview, Ling 3.0 Flash, and Qwen3.8 Flash support.
- [Anthropic Cache] Anthropic-compatible providers can now keep prompt caches for 1 hour from API Settings.
- [i18n] Added initial Turkish localization support across SuperAgent.
- [Screenshot] Confirm the capture on double-click inside the selection rectangle.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Agent Sessions] Pinned agent sessions now remain in their agent group and appear before unpinned sessions.
- [Citations] Knowledge base and web search citations referenced again in a later turn now render as numbered citations and export correctly.
- [WebDAV] WebDAV backups now verify the server's TLS certificate by default. Enable “Allow Self-Signed Certificates” if your server uses a self-signed certificate.
- [Web Search] Web search now prefers model-native search by default, with automatic fallback to configured services.
- [Export] Fixed markdown export with images: oversized embeds are skipped, folder-mode images are copied directly, and broken links are removed.
- [Backup] Shows the available disk space when a backup or restore fails because the disk is full.
- [Chat] Fixed the app freezing for seconds when removing all models of a provider on a large chat history.
- [PDF] Improved PDF previews with selectable text, direct page jumps, and document outlines.
- [Thinking] Fixed thinking time restarting from 0 when switching tabs during streaming.
- [Migration] Fixed v1-to-v2 migration so multi-model conversations preserve the response selected as context.
- [Topics] Fixed a race where deleting the active conversation could leave the UI stuck on the deleted conversation.
- [Topics] Keep pinned conversations inside their assistant group when conversations are grouped by assistant.
- [Composer] Fixed the agent input box sometimes showing a raw knowledge-base prompt sentence after switching sessions.
- [Composer] Long pasted text is pasted as plain text by default again; the “paste long text as file” toggle is back in Input Settings.
- [Provider] Fixed custom request headers not being deletable in the provider request-configuration drawer.
- [Provider] Fixed image generation icon not displaying for OpenRouter models with versioned GPT image IDs.
- [Provider] Restored the Off reasoning option for optional OpenRouter reasoning models.
- [Provider] Corrected reasoning-effort options for Qwen3.8 Flash and Max on DashScope Responses endpoint.
- [Provider] Point the TokenHub “Get API key” link to the API Key management page.
- [Models] Preserve Fireworks Kimi Fast and Turbo variants.
- [Models] Fixed Kimi K2.5 and newer requests failing when assistant sampling settings were enabled.
- [Chat] Fixed the inconsistent edit action on assistant messages so all assistant replies with text are uniformly editable.
- [Chat] Fixed a race where switching the model from the conversation header could leave the next message routed to the previously selected model.
- [Chat] Improved automatic conversation titles by requesting them in the selected language using an explicit language name.
- [Chat] Citation markers that cannot be matched to a source are no longer shown as raw `[cite:...]` text in answers.
- [Chat] Fixed scheduled task cards showing “Running” forever for runs that were cancelled before the app quit.
- [Chat] Fixed the agent heartbeat toggle being ignored for agents migrated from v1.
- [Chat] Fixed the right-side list opening at the same width as the left list and remembering its own width.
- [Chat] Improved focus responsiveness in large Assistant and Agent resource selectors.
- [Chat] Keep thinking elapsed stable across tab switches.
- [Markdown] Fixed rendering of standalone LaTeX environments such as `equation` and `aligned`.
- [Markdown] Fixed table columns keeping a stale fixed width after inserting or resizing columns in the notes editor.
- [Mini Apps] Passing null options to chat or file export no longer rejects with an unexpected error.
- [Mini Apps] Use a fixed 25px size for Mini App tab icons.
- [Mini Apps] Managed DeepSeek Harness sessions no longer open the system browser when they start or restart.
- [Mini Apps] Links inside unauthorized HTML artifact previews can no longer navigate the preview frame.
- [MCP Browser] Restored MCP browser window controls and tab-bar actions on Windows.
- [Knowledge] Reindex now re-acquires files from the real source.
- [Files] Pasting multiple files into the composer no longer drops the remaining files when one fails to read.
- [Painting] Fixed painting migrator leaving dangling model references that disabled the send button.
- [Sidebar] New installs now open Agent first and place it before Chat; existing users keep their saved order.

⚡ Performance
- [Export] Exporting or analyzing a long topic with many web/knowledge searches no longer slows down quadratically.
- [File Preview] Improved file preview startup time by loading supported preview modules while file metadata is checked.

SuperAgent 2.0.10 - Features, Fixes, and Experience Improvements

✨ New Features
- [Mini Apps] Mini apps can now be real local apps: install a .miniapp package from a file or an https manifest, run it in an isolated sandbox, and grant it storage, file, AI, notification and network capabilities per app. Grants, updates, rollback, data and uninstall are managed from the app's detail panel.
- [Tool Approval] Users can provide an optional reason when rejecting Agent and MCP tool calls, and rejected decisions remain visible in tool history.
- [Diagnostics] Cherry Support and Home/Agent conversation errors can now open editable, user-reviewed diagnostic reports without submitting anything automatically.
- [Diagnostics] Diagnostic bundle export and anonymous upload can now optionally include regular chat and Agent session history for troubleshooting.
- [Diagnostics] SuperAgent can now submit user-reviewed diagnostic reports directly to Cherry and display the returned report ID.
- [Providers] First-time API provider setup is now guided through explicit key saving, model selection, and verification before enablement.
- [Knowledge Base] Files can now be dragged into a knowledge base to start the existing upload flow.
- [Notes] The empty notes page now has a Create a new note button.
- [Sidebar] New installs now show Agent as the first left-sidebar entry, then Chat. Existing users keep their current sidebar order.
- [Files] Added Shift-click range selection for file checkboxes.
- [Web Search] Added built-in Parallel Search support with API-key and custom API-host configuration.
- [Models] Added quick token limit presets to the context window, maximum input, and maximum output fields in model settings.
- [CodeMate] Added Hermes Agent and its native web UI to CodeMate.
- [Markdown] Added support for rendering ECharts charts inside echarts code blocks in markdown messages, with theme-aware rendering, split view, copy image, and download image.
- [Export] Exporting conversations to Markdown no longer drops images: you can now embed them as base64 or export them into an assets/ folder.
- [Chat] Token usage details now prioritize complete input/output counts and generation speed, with runtime charts available on demand.
- [Agent] Right-clicking an opened file's header in the Agent workspace now shows a context menu with open-with targets plus edit/preview toggle, refresh, and close.
- [Tasks] Scheduled task cards now distinguish jobs waiting to run from jobs that are actively running, and show the latest run status and next automatic run time.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Providers] Corrected DeepSeek V4 reasoning effort choices and displayed pricing.
- [Models] Fixed Kimi K2.5 and newer requests failing when assistant sampling settings were enabled.
- [Agent] Pi and DSH Agent runtimes on macOS can now use command-line tools configured in the user's login PATH.
- [Agent] Scheduled agent tasks now send one IM channel message per result instead of duplicating the same reply.
- [Startup] Fixed launch at login not being restored correctly after restarting SuperAgent.
- [LM Studio] Fixed LM Studio vision requests so multiple images in one message are forwarded in order.
- [MCP] Allowed stdio MCP servers to use an existing absolute executable path as command, so migrated full-path configs start instead of being rejected.
- [Channels] Localized the close control name on channel log and edit dialogs to follow the selected app language.
- [Chat] Fixed chat sends failing when message history contains literal special-token text.
- [Network] Provider requests now retain authentication headers across safe same-host HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects.
- [Composer] Skill labels now show only in root mixed search results, avoiding redundant labels in the dedicated skills panel.
- [Security] HTML previews of model-generated content no longer run scripts in a same-origin iframe by default; interactive HTML artifacts open in a hardened isolated webview, and unclassified previews fail closed to a script-less sandbox.
- [Diagnostics] AI error diagnosis results now use the language selected in settings for all four output fields.
- [Agent] Show the selected model together with its provider in Agent conversations.
- [Agent] Fixed agent sessions failing every turn with "config.startsWith is not a function" when the provider had custom request headers, and stopped header values containing $ from being mangled.
- [Gemini] Fixed Gemini requests failing when an MCP tool exposes an array without a typed items schema; incompatible tools are skipped so remaining tools can be used.
- [Portable] Fixed provider and model lists disappearing after relaunching the Windows portable app; retryable errors are now shown when provider data cannot be loaded.
- [Sidebar] Fixed sessions/topics in the right-side panel showing new items under "Earlier" instead of "Today" after staying open across days.
- [Agent] Action required: Agent Sessions without a trusted notification target no longer expose notify. Channel Sessions now default to their source channel, while scheduled cron and heartbeat runs use only their configured task channels.
- [Moonshot] Fixed HTTP 400 errors from the official Moonshot API by omitting unsupported top_p values for Kimi K2.5 and K3 models.
- [Providers] Fixed GLM-5.3-Flash Auto requests on OpenRouter and OpenCode Go, and added its current multimodal and reasoning capabilities to the provider registry.
- [Claude Code] HuggingFace-hosted models (e.g. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) no longer fail with "Request too large (max 32MB)" when used in a claude-code type Agent; tool descriptions with control characters are now sanitized.
- [About] GitHub icon and app logo now have accessible names for screen readers, and decorative images are hidden from the accessibility tree.
- [Pi] Fixed Pi agents returning empty responses after automatic context compaction.
- [Agent] DSH agents now receive the user's custom feedback after a tool call is rejected.
- [Chat] Fixed Regenerate continuing to use the previous response model after the current chat model was switched.
- [Model Selector] Show the selected model together with its provider and removed redundant provider labels from grouped model menu rows.
- [Agent] Made Cherry-managed command-line tools available to the built-in Pi agent Bash tool.
- [Usage] Capped the Usage Statistics dashboard width so cards and charts stay readable on ultrawide windows.
- [Network] Fixed ERR_CONNECTION_TIMED_OUT for third-party APIs requiring a proxy/VPN (e.g. yunwu.ai) when using Azure-hosted Claude models; the azure-anthropic provider variant now correctly forwards the proxy-aware fetch.
- [Chat] Fixed legacy conversations that could fail on Responses API providers after parallel tool calls.
- [Updater] Fixed Check for updates so unpublished/503 channels show a friendly message instead of the raw HTTP body.
- [Chat] Meta-tool cards now localize section titles and empty states with the UI language.
- [Notes] Fixed copying mathematical formulas from Notes so pasting into chat preserves them as LaTeX.
- [Web Search] Fixed SearXNG web search failing with "No enabled general web search engines found" when the instance tags enabled engines as general only.
- [Artifact Pane] Long lines now wrap when editing a file in the agent artifact preview overlay.
- [Chat] Improved Quick Assistant translation smoothness, prevented message action labels from being copied with AI replies, and kept streaming responses clear of the composer gap.
- [Chat] Fixed token usage details staying open or reopening after clicking the token count to locate a message.
- [Chat] Fixed intermittent keyboard scrolling jitter and stalls in long chat conversations.
- [Mini Apps] Fixed the mini app's loading mask briefly flashing over the tab when switching from an open mini app to Agents, Chat, or another view.
- [Copilot] Fixed GitHub Copilot authorization failures when custom request headers are configured.
- [Diagnostics] Error diagnosis now distinguishes real proxy connection failures from unrelated messages that merely mention a proxy.
- [CodeMate] Fixed inconsistent icon sizing and truncated tool names in the CodeMate sidebar.
- [Nutstore] Cleaned up abandoned Nutstore SSO attempts so stale callbacks and timers cannot affect later logins.
- [Moonshot] Fixed HTTP 400 errors by omitting unsupported top_p for Kimi K2.5 and K3 models.
- [Chat] Message token usage in the footer toolbar is now always shown, instead of being hidden by the "Show estimated tokens" input setting.
- [Quick Panel] Fixed quick panel submenus (knowledge base, quick phrases, notes, MCP, skills) not filtering as you type in the composer.
- [Assistant] Custom parameter string and number value fields now expose descriptive names to screen readers.
- [Tools] Managed DeepSeek Harness installations that are missing @deepseek-ai/dsh-scope are now reported as broken in Toolchain instead of appearing healthy and failing at startup, so Retry can reinstall them.
- [Gemini] Fixed 400 error "Please enable tool_config.include_server_side_tool_invocations" when using Gemini 3.x models with built-in web search / URL context together with MCP or other function tools on the official Gemini API.
- [Composer] Link chips now use a fixed link-blue instead of following the customizable theme color.
- [Selection Assistant] Selection Assistant custom-action dialogs now keep confirmation controls accessible when prompts are very long.
- [Artifact Pane] Fixed the maximized file pane in agent sessions: code preview and edit surfaces now extend full height under the floating message input instead of cutting off above it.
- [AI Provider] Fixed the OpenAI Responses protocol failing with AI_TypeValidationError against third-party providers (e.g. Volcano Ark Agent plan) that omit the annotations field in their replies.
- [Claude Code] Prevented Claude Code Agent sessions using text-only models from becoming unusable after the Read tool opens an image file.
- [Providers] Fixed MiniMax M3 Agent sessions to use the provider's native Anthropic Messages endpoint, avoiding intermittent reasoning-block translation failures while keeping ordinary chat on Chat Completions.
- [Analytics] Fixed duplicate app launch analytics events when data collection is re-enabled during the same app session.
- [API] OpenAI-compatible chat completions now report cached prompt tokens in their usage metadata.
- [Mini Apps] Fixed mini app orphaned tab pool state cleanup.
- [Chat] Fixed rapid previous and next message navigation jumping to the wrong conversation turn.
- [Input] Fixed an issue where completing Chinese IME input while renaming a conversation could leave a stuck drag preview and block subsequent dragging.
- [Web Search] Web Search now uses the current local date when interpreting requests such as "this month" or "the last 30 days", preventing stale-month queries across providers.
- [Skills] Refined Skill icons and type badges with a consistent light blue-violet treatment and improved detail header alignment.
- [Startup] Launch at login now uses the stable launcher path for portable Windows builds.
- [Agent] Improved subagent flow readability and fixed the sidebar running indicator for detached subagents.
- [Spell Check] Fixed spell check real-time highlighting and multi-language synchronization failures on Windows.
- [Markdown] Fixed chat message rendering where a bolded URL followed by punctuation (e.g. **https://…**note) produced a dead link with the markers swallowed into it; such text now renders as a bold clickable link, consistent with the Notes editor.

💄 Improvements
- [Files] File type filters now paginate matching rows directly instead of scanning and hydrating unrelated file pages.

⚡ Performance
- [Files] Stabilized virtualized view callbacks for smoother scrolling.
- [Files] File type filters now paginate matching rows directly instead of scanning and hydrating unrelated file pages.
- [Home/Agents] Isolated tab-state side effects from page roots for smoother tab switching.
- [Notes] Lazy-loaded optional menu workflows.
- [Files] Hydrated only the visible view to reduce memory and CPU.
- [Chat] Lazy-loaded the agent tool renderer to speed up chat loading.
- [Translate] The Translate page no longer re-renders the full markdown document on every streaming frame, and one-shot code highlighting now runs in the shiki worker instead of blocking the main thread.
- [Agent] Stabilized the system prompt prefix to reduce per-turn overhead.
- [Backup] Parallelized device metadata reads so backup filename preparation no longer serializes independent system metadata reads.
- [CLI] CLI configuration drafts and clear operations now process independent files concurrently.
- [Composer] Preserved dependency-scoped registrations in composer tools.
- [Data Settings] Lazy-loaded inactive panels in data settings.
- [Files] File type filters paginate matching rows directly instead of scanning and hydrating unrelated file pages.

SuperAgent 2.0.9 - Features, Fixes, and Experience Improvements

✨ New Features
- [WeChat] Agents can now send documents and videos through WeChat channels, while incoming video and voice messages are saved to the Agent workspace.
- [Skills] Installed Skill details once again show the source file tree and content preview, with optional one-click Chinese translation for Markdown files.
- [Skills] Installed Skill details now include an action to open the managed skill folder.
- [Agent] Agent sessions now automatically discover workspace skills stored under .agents/skills.
- [Appearance] Chat conversation list and work task list positions can now be changed from Settings → Appearance.
- [Sidebar] Sidebar items can now be opened in a new tab with middle-click or the context menu.
- [Models] Added DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp with image input support.
- [Export] Notion export now converts GitHub-style Markdown alerts into native Notion callout blocks.
- [Files] The Agent workspace file tree now offers a context-menu action to copy a file path.
- [Prompts] Prompts can now be global or limited to selected contexts, with context-specific ordering and management in Settings.
- [MCP] Agents can now register an MCP server in one step; new servers remain inactive and untrusted until enabled unless activation was explicitly requested.
- [Usage] Redesigned usage analytics with a clearer overview, independent request sorting, and interactive charts.
- [Mini Apps] Mini apps can now be shown side by side in a split view.
- [Sidebar] Assistants and Agents can now be pinned to the sidebar for quick access to their latest conversation.
- [Providers] Provider and model catalog updates can now be delivered without waiting for an app release.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Providers] Model deletion now keeps the model list synchronized when a request reports failure after the model was already removed.
- [Providers] Updating provider settings now preserves untouched nested options and correctly removes explicitly cleared values.
- [Screenshot] Capture overlays now remain on the active macOS Space.
- [Composer] Fixed the first paperclip attachment not appearing immediately after switching to an unused assistant.
- [Agent] Fixed an immediate retry after stopping a session returning an empty or stalled response or losing Claude Code resume state.
- [UI] Fixed the left sidebar resize handle becoming misaligned after returning from Settings.
- [Code Editor] Fixed artifact file previews not filling or scrolling correctly and restored syntax highlighting for Markdown, TSX, TOML, Vue, PHP, and other file types.
- [Painting] Painting size selections now keep their full outline visible.
- [Settings] Generic Settings entry points now consistently open Model Services.
- [LM Studio] Fixed LM Studio models not appearing in Pi and DeepSeek Harness Agent model pickers.
- [Gemini] Fixed Gemini 3 latest aliases failing after the first tool call because replayed calls lacked thought signatures.
- [Painting] Image count controls now reject fractional values while continuous controls retain decimal precision.
- [Markdown] Fixed streamed inline code appearing abruptly and occasionally causing a rendering error.
- [Agent] Global search no longer exposes hidden model reasoning, and existing search data is cleaned automatically.
- [Agent] Referenced conversations are now treated as historical context and cannot authorize Agent actions.
- [Composer] Fixed pasted Windows screenshots being dropped when the clipboard also contains text.
- [Gemini] Fixed Gemini 3.x requests failing with HTTP 400 when web search and MCP tools are used together.
- [Agent] Deleting an Agent now also removes its scheduled tasks instead of leaving them running and failing in the background.
- [Migration] An unreadable legacy Agent database no longer blocks v2 migration; it is preserved and reported while remaining data continues migrating.
- [Input] Confirming a Chinese, Japanese, or Korean IME candidate no longer saves raw composition text when renaming a conversation.
- [Onboarding] Fixed a fresh installation crashing on the model-selection step.
- [Markdown] Copying a table now returns the original Markdown table instead of unrelated message content.
- [CodeMate] Fixed DeepSeek Harness failing to launch when old managed API-key entries remain in its credentials file.
- [MCP] Fixed workspace file search failing to parse ripgrep results correctly.
- [Prompts] Prompt and translation placeholders now preserve literal replacement text, including special replacement characters.
- [Artifact Pane] Fixed the elevated composer remaining visible after maximizing the artifact pane.
- [QuickPanel] Fixed hidden actions remaining clickable after switching back to a tab.
- [Models] Recognized custom models now inherit missing registry descriptions and input/output capabilities.
- [PDF] Fixed BabelDOC installation failing in mainland China by using accessible Python, font, and model mirrors.

SuperAgent 2.0.8 - Features, Fixes, and Performance

✨ New Features
- [MCP] MCP prompts and resources are now usable from the composer: pick a prompt to insert its text with Tab-fillable argument fields, or pick a resource to attach its content. Assistants can also browse and read MCP resources through new mcp_resource_list / mcp_resource_read tools.
- [PDF] Add layout-preserving PDF translation via BabelDOC on the Translate page. Install the BabelDOC plugin from Settings → Environment Dependencies to translate PDFs while keeping their original layout, previewed side by side with the source.
- [PDF] PDF translations are now saved to Translation History, and the translated PDF is added to the file manager. Open a history entry to reopen the preview, or to open, reveal, or save the translated PDF.
- [Screenshot] Added a built-in screen capture tool. Use the global shortcut to select any region across your displays, annotate it with rectangles, arrows, drawing, text, or mosaic, then copy or save the result. Local OCR can recognize selectable text directly in the capture. Enable it under Settings → Screenshot.
- [Agent] Add durable, auditable requests and asynchronous completion results between Agent Sessions, with trusted attribution, queue state, search, and restart recovery.
- [Agent] Agent task progress now appears in a floating capsule above the composer with live progress and hover details.
- [Agent] Pi Agent Runtime now uses Code Mode to discover and orchestrate MCP tools with tool_search, tool_describe, tool_call, and approval-gated tool_exec.
- [Agent] SuperAgent now shows completion notifications for Agent tasks and assistant responses, using in-app cards for other sessions and system notifications when the app is in the background.
- [Skills] Added global enable/disable switches for installed skills. Globally disabled skills remain installed and are removed from Agent skill selection in real time.
- [Settings] Reorganized settings with a new General page for system and assistant context preferences.
- [Settings] Provider settings now provide one Model Check action for checking a single model or all models. Both workflows use consistent masked API key selectors with progress and per-key results.
- [Fetch] Web fetch tools can now reach local network addresses. A new Settings → General toggle, "Allow fetching local network addresses", is on by default. Turn it off if you run sensitive services locally.
- [Shortcuts] Improved the Keyboard Shortcuts settings page with compact search, filtering, and bulk actions.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Agent] Fix the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent runtime failing to start on Linux with "Failed to load native module: pty.node".
- [Agent] Fix DSH tool approval cards that could disappear when bridge and session events arrived out of order.
- [Agent] Fix DSH agent web search: results now render as a source card with clickable links, and inline citation markers resolve instead of showing raw [cite:id] text.
- [Agent] Fix DSH subagent output occasionally rendering under the wrong tool card after a send_message follow-up to a running subagent.
- [Agent] Fix Agent creation not automatically selecting the configured default model for Pi and DeepSeek Harness when it is enabled and compatible.
- [Agent] Fix ExitPlanMode approval and denied headless tool records showing an empty tool preview instead of the generated plan.

- [Agent] Fix agents failing with "tool parameter root must be an object type" when using xAI/Grok models with the built-in notify tool.
- [Agent] Fix Fast (Pi) agents in "Approve for Me" mode asking for permission when reading enabled Cherry-managed skills.
- [Agent] Fix Pi Agent requests ignoring SuperAgent's configured proxy environment.
- [Agent] Fix the right-pane file preview placing text, Markdown, and HTML against the panel edges and allowing long lines in text files to overflow horizontally.
- [Ollama] Fix Ollama health check causing UI to freeze for ~30 seconds by using a lightweight probe instead of the full text generation pipeline.
- [Ollama] Fix Ollama Qwen models not displaying inline `<think>` reasoning in the collapsible reasoning block.
- [Ollama] Fix Ollama reasoning models skipping their thinking process when reasoning mode is set to Default.
- [Ollama] Fix Agent mode failing with a 400 error when using Ollama models that do not support thinking.
- [Chat] Fix message edit and translation resetting the message's saved reasoning effort and fast mode.
- [Chat] Fix the missing edit action on assistant replies from providers that annotate their output, such as every OpenAI Responses API reply.
- [Chat] Fix conversations remaining named "New Chat" when auto naming is disabled by using the first user message as the fallback title.

- [Translation] Fix slow or blank selection translation results with Bailian Qwen Responses models.

- [UI] Fix the Paintings model list reordering itself after selecting a model.
- [UI] Fix Feishu agent channels with official SDK reliability, persistent conversation isolation, and thread/topic support in group chats.
- [UI] Fix local embedding initialization failures on Linux after the ONNX inference worker restarts.
- [UI] Fix images attached to models without Vision now using OCR and stopping with a configuration prompt when OCR is unavailable or fails.

- [UI] Fix context variables passed to the built-in Python tool being injected into the script's execution scope.
- [UI] Fix a startup JavaScript error when a proxy or network gateway returns non-ASCII response headers.
- [UI] Fix web fetching failing behind fake-IP proxies and on IPv6-only networks.

⚡ Performance
- Reduced main-process stalls: file reads (Notes search), Word export and image save no longer block the whole app while reading files or showing save dialogs.
- Improved scrolling smoothness for expanded conversation resource lists.

SuperAgent 2.0.7 - New Features, Fixes, and Performance

✨ New Features
- [xlsx-preview] Preview .xlsx spreadsheets directly in the artifact preview pane: multi-sheet tabs, cell styles and merged cells, floating images and charts, formula results, click-to-expand cell content, and photographic zoom.
- [MCP] Add built-in QVeris Hosted MCP integration with API key setup guidance.
- [Help] Added a localized Help & Feedback menu with the in-app update feature list and history, documentation and repository shortcuts, anonymous diagnostic upload, Cherry Support feedback, and GitHub Issues
- [Agent] Agents no longer stop at a maximum turn count — a long autonomous run continues until it finishes or is interrupted. To keep a hard cap, set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TURNS in the agent's environment variables
- [Agent] Fast (Pi) agents gain an "Approve for Me" permission mode and new ones start in it — the agent works on its own and asks when it recognizes a risky action. "Full Access" on a Fast (Pi) agent is now unconditional. The agent create dialog now picks the runtime with flat cards, and the edit dialog shows the (unchangeable) runtime
- [Agent] Add DeepSeek Harness (dsh) as a third agent runtime for agent sessions, with tool approvals, host-bridged MCP and Cherry built-in tools, skills, context-usage reporting, auto-compaction, /compact and /goal commands, provider retry status, and OpenTelemetry tracing
- [Code Mate] Code Mate can now install and run DeepSeek Harness with Cherry providers or the Unified Gateway, with managed settings, Web UI access, and a Launchpad shortcut
- [Chat] Composer shortcuts for send, line break, and steer are now configurable in Settings → Chat → Input. While an Agent is running, the new steer shortcut (⌘Enter on macOS, Ctrl+Enter elsewhere) sends your message straight into the current turn instead of queueing it. Shift+Enter still inserts a line break. On Windows and Linux the send shortcut drops the Win/Super+Enter option that the OS reserved and that never worked

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [i18n] Translate previously untranslated Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and spreadsheet preview text across supported locales.
- [Shortcuts] Caps Lock can now be bound as a shortcut key.
- [Skills] Fixed online Skill installation hanging indefinitely or failing to reach GitHub: the clone step is now bounded by a timeout, never waits on a credential prompt, and follows the proxy configured in SuperAgent.
- [Providers] Fix providers using the native OpenAI adapter (official OpenAI, Codex, TokenHub, DMXAPI, and any provider on an `openai-responses` endpoint) failing to start with `Failed to create provider "openai"`.
- [Agent] Fix usage and cost attribution for dsh agent sessions routed through the local API Gateway: provider requests now carry the session usage headers, so usage records attach to the owning agent message and reuse a stable per-session prompt cache key.
- [Code Mate] Fixed Code Mate installation of DeepSeek Harness when mise upgrades Node at the same time.
- [Composer] Fixed the composer input collapsing to two lines after switching topics/agents, hiding part of a saved draft.
- [DSH] Fix DeepSeek Harness agents failing to start in packaged builds when subprocess dependencies were left inside app.asar.
- [Backup] Delayed overdue automatic backups briefly after startup so they no longer interrupt messages immediately after launch.
- [Models] Restored the SiliconFlow referral link used by the Get API Key action.
- [Web Search] Fixed an issue where importing an MCP server from ModelScope could leave settings unresponsive when the Web Search API key dialog was open.
- [Chat] Starting a branch from the latest assistant message now creates a real two-way branch instead of a linear empty continuation.
- [Models] Fix custom OpenAI-compatible providers incorrectly displaying metadata from a same-family model with a different parameter size
- [Models] Fix MiniMax-M3 requests failing because the app requested more than the provider's supported output-token limit
- [Models] Fix provider model rows shifting in Settings when a model group is collapsed or expanded
- [Chat] Fix chat messages, prompt previews, and translations rendering single line breaks as spaces — in-paragraph newlines now display as actual line breaks, matching AI output conventions
- [Chat] Fix a v2.0.5 regression where attaching an image to a model without declared vision support failed the turn with an error — the image is sent to the provider again, so models behind gateways or proxies that accept images work as before
- [Chat] Generated images from Agent tool calls are now displayed directly in the conversation instead of being hidden in collapsed tool history
- [Chat] Fix the first keystroke being lost when focusing the chat/agent composer input
- [Chat] Fix composer input history so the first Arrow Up press recalls the previous entry and places the caret at the end of the recalled text
- [Chat] Fix clipboard files being attached twice when pasting into the chat composer before its rich editor finished loading

- [Agent] Fix agent skills picked from the composer being reported as missing on the first call when the skill's display name differs from its directory name
- [Agent] Fix @ file references in Agent chat only finding files within the first three levels of the working directory — files in more deeply nested subdirectories are now searchable

SuperAgent 2.0.4 - New Features, Fixes, and Performance

✨ New Features
- [Composer] Tool permission requests in Agent sessions can now be approved with Enter or denied with Esc
- [Context] Restored a "recent messages kept" context limit available globally in Settings → Model and per assistant, plus a new Context Management section exposing master switch, message limit, tool-output truncation threshold, auto-compress, and compression model
- [Web Search] Add Querit fetchUrls capability. Querit.ai offers 1,000 free API requests for new users
- [MCP Hub] MCP clients connecting to the local API gateway can now open a session to receive live tool-list updates and progress from long-running tools
- [MCP Hub] Restored the MCP-over-HTTP endpoints on the local API gateway so external tools can once again use SuperAgent as a local MCP hub. Action required: clients written against the 1.9.x endpoints should stop unwrapping the `{ success, data }` envelope and stop relying on `Mcp-Session-Id` — the proxy is now stateless
- [Agent] Agent conversations can now mention accessible workspace folders with @
- [Agent] Add workspace deletion from the shared selector with an impact preview for sessions, agent channels, and scheduled tasks while preserving files on disk
- [Models] Add configurable model pricing tiers based on input token count, with separate input, output, cache-read, and cache-write rates for each tier
- [Shortcuts] Added configurable keyboard shortcuts for switching to the next or previous tab
- [QQ Bot] QQ channel bots can now receive all group messages (not just @mentions) when the per-channel "mention-only" toggle is off and the QQ Open Platform permission is enabled
- [Notes] Added a "Back to top" button for long notes, plus a new "Line Break Mode" setting that renders single line breaks as new lines (Obsidian-style) without modifying the source files
- [Local Model] Add DirectML (Windows) and CoreML (macOS) hardware acceleration for local models
- [Files] Enforce document input limits on file processing
- [Privacy] Agent sessions now run the bundled Claude Agent SDK with non-essential traffic disabled, so the bundled CLI no longer sends telemetry, error reports or background config fetches to Anthropic

🐛 Bug Fixes
- [Web Search] Fix Zhipu web search failing with a missing API key error even after the Zhipu API key was configured in model provider settings
- [Rename] Fix Agent session, topic, and history record rename saving the raw pinyin instead of the Chinese title when confirming an IME candidate with Enter
- [Chat] Conversation recency now follows actual chat activity, so renaming, moving, reordering, or other metadata changes no longer make an older conversation appear recent
- [Workspace] Show the official Windows Terminal icon in the agent workspace open-in menu on Windows
- [Chat] Fix multi-model Retry, Retry All, and @ model replies so they target the correct live execution, stale retry state cannot reappear, and repeated replies from the same model remain visible in multi-model message groups
- [Knowledge Base] Prevent knowledge-base imports and migrations from producing overlong filenames when resolving name collisions
- [Errors] Chat and provider connection-check errors now show the service provider's own error message instead of bare HTTP status text, and an HTTP 403 is no longer reported as an invalid API key
- [OAuth] Fix Codex and Grok CLI OAuth sign-in so pending browser authorization can be canceled and immediately retried without stale callbacks or cancellation requests disrupting the new flow
- [Navigation] Fix navigation to /app/* routes (e.g. opening the feedback assistant) and to routes carrying query strings being blocked by the main-window route allowlist
- [CherryIN] CherryIN chat now blocks native audio attachments for Qwen models that do not support audio, preventing failed upstream requests
- [DeepSeek] Fix DeepSeek auto thinking mode sending an invalid thinking.type "auto" parameter that caused chat start to fail with an AI SDK type validation error
- [Prompt] Fix assistant/agent prompt preview collapsing multi-line system prompts into a single line
- [UI] Fix the close button of tall dialogs (e.g. the provider editor after expanding "more settings") becoming unclickable where it overlaps the window title bar
- [Web Search] Fix the built-in @cherry/fetch tool and web search page fetching failing with "HTTP error: 301" on URLs that redirect
- [Models] Fix model selector tag filters appearing cut off: the filter row now shows an edge fade when more tags are hidden, making horizontal overflow visible
- [Models] Fix long model names overlapping the capability icons in the model management drawer
- [Doubao] Fix Doubao model connection checks failing with "Invalid JSON response" when Ark omits output text annotations
- [OCR] Fix System OCR on Windows still failing for JPEG, GIF and WebP images: images are now transcoded to PNG before recognition
- [OCR] Fix System OCR on Windows failing on every JPEG image (WIC error 0x88982F07): the native engine now receives image bytes instead of a file path, which also fixes BMP/TIFF/GIF/WebP/HEIF inputs
- [Agent] Fix agent sessions on models whose catalog output cap equals their context window (such as DeepSeek V4 Pro) compacting repeatedly from 100K tokens on, and stop the context-usage readout from reporting the compaction budget as the model's context window
- [macOS] Hide the macOS Dock icon when minimizing to tray on close (and on launch-to-tray), restoring v1 behavior
- [Agent] Fix an issue where multiple tool permission requests in one reply could stall the conversation and require switching conversations to continue
- [Painting] Fix painting size controls and the parameter popover covering nearby content
- [Agent] Work agent sessions interrupted by an abnormal exit no longer resume the interrupted Claude Code execution. On restart their history is preserved and settled, and the next reply starts from a fresh runtime connection
- [Agent] Fix agent session streams rendering fragmented or duplicated reasoning blocks after reconnecting to a long-running turn (stream replay buffer overflow)
- [MCP] MCP server logs can now be selected and copied — added a "Copy logs" button to the MCP server logs tab
- [Agent] Scheduled tasks for the same agent can now run up to three jobs concurrently instead of always running sequentially
- [Agent] Prevent internal Claude Agent system reminders from appearing in conversations and newly persisted assistant messages
- [Painting] Fix long prompts pasted into Painting still appearing blank after the initial long-text paste fix
- [Agent] Fix the agent edit dialog trapping users after a failed save; a repeat explicit close now discards the unsaved change and exits
- [Bailian] Fix Bailian models failing with "Normal mode does not support web_extractor" when thinking is disabled: web search now works in non-thinking mode without the web extractor tool
- [Windows] Fix command discovery for bundled Git and user-installed tools located in Windows paths containing non-ASCII characters
- [Knowledge Base] Fix knowledge base lists not loading entries beyond the first 100 records
- [Assistant] Fix assistant edits that could fail and trap users in the edit dialog when legacy settings were present
- [Mini App] Reopening a mini app from the sidebar now switches to its existing tab instead of replacing the current tab
- [Topic Naming] Fix auto-generated conversation and agent-session titles: the naming request no longer carries the assistant's tool configuration, so auto-naming no longer fails when the assistant has web search enabled and the naming model cannot combine disabled thinking with a web tool
- [Code Viewer] Fix long unbreakable lines (base64, URLs, minified JSON) in chat code blocks and the trace call-chain detail view being clipped / not wrapping when auto-wrap is enabled. They now wrap correctly; disabling wrap still scrolls horizontally
- [Sidebar] Preserved collapsed assistant folders in the classic conversation sidebar when switching between Chat and Work
- [Backup] Fix automatic backups running again shortly after every app restart instead of respecting the configured interval
- [Shortcuts] Fix window-local zoom shortcuts being captured by SuperAgent while it is unfocused
- [Agent] Fix Agent workspace file mentions so files in deeper nested folders can be found with @ search. Action required: when OCR cannot extract text from an image attached to a text-only model, SuperAgent now stops before sending the request and asks you to choose a vision-capable model or remove the image
- [Migration] Fix "No tool output found for tool call" when continuing a conversation migrated from v1 that used MCP tools
- [Image Viewer] Fix rotation and flip not being baked into the saved image
- [Thinking Block] Fix the "Auto-collapse thinking content" setting having no effect when disabled — turning it off now keeps thinking blocks expanded
- [MCP] Fix npx/uv stdio MCP servers not resolving on Windows when launched via the system PATH
- [MCP] Propagate the stream abort signal into in-flight MCP tool calls, so aborting a reply reliably cancels running MCP tools
- [Models] Fix model sizes being lost when multiple models share the same family key
- [Settings] Disabling the system tray now also disables the quick assistant's tray-click launch option

⚡ Performance
- [Chat] Fix renderer crashes ("app suddenly closes") during long fast streaming replies, caused by quadratic memory growth in stream handling and rendering. Very large streamed replies now render with bounded memory, and oversized single markdown blocks no longer fail to render
